name: Land Development of Nimrodi Group Ltd.
summary: Land Development of Nimrodi Group Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the real estate business in Israel, Poland, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Rental of Properties in Israel; Rental of Properties Abroad; Development of Residential Construction in Israel; and Development of Residential Construction Abroad. The company develops and constructs commercial, office, and residential projects; and develops, leases, and operates logistic centers, light industries, and logistics parks in Poland, Germany, Romania, and Austria.
